articles.title_en: Sanctioned Russian tanker leaks oil off Oman after mystery explosion

articles.title_en: Russia’s parliamentary race loses antiwar party that attracted young volunteers ‘because they don’t want to be killed’ in Ukraine, chairman said
articles.lead_en: Russia’s Supreme Court has ruled to remove the Yabloko party from the State Duma ballot, granting a lawsuit brought by the Rodina party. The ruling came after Nikolai Rybakov, Yabloko’s chairman, delivered a closing argument urging the court to dismiss Rodina’s lawsuit entirely.

articles.title_en: Power goes dark across a Russian resort city under drone warning, a week after a beach strike killed seven
articles.lead_en: Residents of Gelendzhik began reporting citywide power outages on the afternoon of August 10, the news outlet 93.ru reported. A warning of possible Ukrainian drone attacks had been in effect in the city since early morning; sirens were sounding periodically, and the beaches were closed.
